page: Microsoft Azure NG32ads_V620_v1 is a specialized GPU-accelerated virtual machine within the NGADSV620v1 family, architected for visual computing and graphics virtualization. Built on an x86_64 AMD processor and managed through the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by one AMD V620 GPU equipped with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. In addition to graphics processing capabilities, the server bundles 4,940 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing extensive low-latency physical disk space directly attached to the host. The instance is also capable of attaching Premium Storage volumes.

From an infrastructure perspective, the server does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The integration of 4,940 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity offers high qualitative cost efficiency for operations that require extensive scratch space, eliminating the immediate necessity for supplementary external managed disks during localized disk-intensive operations.

The hardware configuration is well suited for workloads such as cloud gaming streaming, virtual desktop infrastructure, 3D rendering, video transcoding, and media processing pipelines that rely on AMD GPU acceleration combined with fast, high-capacity local storage.
